Microsoft | Software Engineer II – M365 Copilot Growth | Redmond, WA | Full-time | Onsite

We're the team making Copilot indispensable. Building AI features inside Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook, and the Copilot app that users actually reach for every day.

You'll own capabilities end to end, run experiments that move the dial, and collaborate with designers + PMs to ship fast. The tech stack adapts to the problem. The impact? Measured in millions of users and their productivity gains.

We obsess over one thing: getting users to that "wow" moment as fast as possible. If you like shipping, learning, and seeing your code change how people work, this is it.

Job description (currently not accepting because I am going through applicants, but role is still open): https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/197039355675...

Feel free to send me your resume and questions at kapil.tundwal at microsoft.com with HN in subject
